non_observed_dispositions.deferred: visible as a rejected candidate with its state.reason; never a value
non_observed_dispositions.ambiguous: visible as a contradicted candidate; multiple distinct values or contexts for one fact slot

common_shares_outstanding.note: Two named XBRL concepts, one metric kind; the cover-page DEI count and the balance-sheet count are separate facts with their own period_end and filing and are never silently substituted for each other.

public_float.note: A dollar value of non-affiliate equity at the float measurement date. It is never a share count and never stands in for non_affiliate_public_float shares, issued_and_outstanding or any other share basis (A16).

unadmitted_share_bases.weighted_average_eps: No admitted producer. us-gaap WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasic/Diluted are not in share_count_truth.SUPPORTED_FACTS. The Fundamental Forensics catalog (config/fundamental_forensics/metrics/v1/metric_catalog.yaml) carries basic_weighted_average_shares and diluted_weighted_average_shares, but FIF is not an A17 share-source owner and is not admitted here; admitting it is a separate seat decision. A period-average EPS denominator is never an outstanding count (A16).
unadmitted_share_bases.non_affiliate_public_float: No admitted producer of a non-affiliate share count; dei:EntityPublicFloat is USD and is not converted to shares by price.
unadmitted_share_bases.assumed_as_converted: Owned by instrument terms (O1/O3), not by the share-count source.
unadmitted_share_bases.scenario_incremental_issuance: Owned by scenarios, not by the share-count source.
unadmitted_share_bases.potentially_resalable_existing: Owned by registration/resale terms, not by the share-count source.
unadmitted_share_bases.reserved_for_issuance: Instrument and plan terms, not Company Facts.

consumer_rules: B1 consumes caller-supplied observations through ShareInputs bound to one of admitted_input_schemas; it never fetches, never reads R2, never reads a local pointer and never calls a producer.

An observed ledger never selects the denominator by itself: selection requires an observed common_shares_outstanding fact whose period_end and filing are at or before as_of, with no contradicting candidate for the same instant.
public_float USD facts never substitute for any share basis, and no share basis substitutes for another; a unit or date mismatch refuses or yields contradicted, never the largest or newest value.
deferred and ambiguous observations stay visible as rejected or contradicted candidates with their reasons.
The binding support for share_count_observations is at most partial and always names support_limits; unavailable when no observations are supplied.
Every authority flag on consumed observations stays false; the result is context only (A48).
